meta.name: codex-advisor
meta.description: This skill should be used when the user asks for a "GPT second opinion", wants a "cross-model review", needs to "check a plan before committing", wants another view after repeated failures, or explicitly invokes "codex-advisor".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 获取AI第二意见，审查计划与决策
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果在做重要决策前需要不同角度的AI建议
copy.tagline_en: Get a second opinion from AI to review plans and decisions
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need a different perspective from AI before making important decisions

howto.what: 装上后，当用户需要第二意见时，Claude会将请求转给Codex CLI中的GPT模型进行审查，并直接返回审查结果。若Codex未安装或未登录，则报错。
howto.when: 当用户要求“GPT second opinion”、“cross-model review”、“check a plan before committing”，或多次失败后寻求另一种观点，或明确说“codex-advisor”时触发。

say.text: 帮我检查一下这个计划是否可行。
我试了好几次都失败了，换个视角看看。
say.note: 在重复失败后寻求新方案。

howto.what_en: When the user wants a second opinion, Claude delegates the request to the GPT model via Codex CLI and returns the review result directly. If Codex is missing or not authenticated, an error is surfaced.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks for a 'GPT second opinion', 'cross-model review', 'check a plan before committing', wants another view after repeated failures, or explicitly invokes 'codex-advisor'.

say_en.text: Give me a GPT second opinion.
Check this plan before I commit.
I've failed multiple times, try a different perspective.
say_en.note: Request a fresh view after repeated failures.
